operations.description: Represents the turn-by-turn directions, geometry, distance, and time of the shortest path or fastest path between given start and end points
operations.summary: Get the directions, path, distance and travel time between a series of geographic points
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] directions output format [PARAMS] correct criteria departure description disable distance format output points round route side srs trip unit [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents the distance and time of the shortest or fastest path between given start and end points.
operations.summary: Get distance and travel time between two geographic points
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] distance output format [PARAMS] correct criteria departure description disable distance format output points round route side srs trip unit [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents the distance and time of the shortest or fastest paths between all pairs of fromPoints and toPoints. The number of fromPoints times the number of toPoints should not exceed 100 or the request will time out.
operations.summary: Get distance and travel time between each pair of geographic points
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] distance between pairs output format [PARAMS] correct criteria departure description disable distance format from max output pairs points route side srs to unit [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents the turn-by-turn directions, geometry, distance, and time of the shortest path or fastest path between a start point and a series of end points which are reordered to minimize distance/time
operations.summary: Get the directions, optimal path, distance and travel time between a start point and a series of end points which are reordered to minimize total distance or time.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] optimal directions output format [PARAMS] correct criteria departure description disable distance format output points round route side srs trip unit [SCHEMA]
